correctness.rationale: PASS: Dirichlet ON basis e_n=z^n/√(n+1) yields factorable matrix c_nd_k for k≤n, c_n=[√(n+1)log(e+n)^β]^{-1}, d_k=(k+1)^{-1/2}. Embedding n into logarithmic intervals [log(n+1),log(n+2)) gives exact A=E*VβE+(1/2)diag(c_nd_n); the Hardy inequality proves β=1 bounded and diagonal multiplication handles β≥1. Widely separated logarithmic blocks of weakly-null unit vectors provide ||Ax||²≥const R^{2−2β}, yielding unboundedness β<1 and noncompactness at β=1. Dyadic Volterra partition into same-block weighted Volterra S_p terms and preceding-block rank-one terms, each O(2^{j(1−β)}), gives membership in all S_p,p>1 for β>1; diagonal correction belongs S1 for β>1. On n∈[2^j,2^{j+1}), compressed J_{2^j} has singular values [2sin((2k−1)π/(4N+2))]^{-1}, giving trace norm ∼(j+1)^{1−β}; S1 block pinching forces β>2. For β>2, diagonal-block norms and earlier-block rank-one norms O((j+1)^{1/2−β}) are summable, establishing S1. Independently checked basis coefficients and J_N singular spectrum for finite N; infinite statements from these analytic estimates, not tests.
